title: 18.3: A 93.3dB SNDR, 180.4dB FoMs Calibration-Free Noise-Shaping Pipelined-SAR ADC with Cross-Stage Gain-Mismatch-Error-Shaping Technique and Negative-R-Assisted Residue Integrator
problem: High-resolution pipelined-SAR ADCs suffer from mismatch errors and inter-stage gain errors; prior gain-error-shaping (GES) schemes introduce multi-bit feedback with additional mismatch sources (truncation and quantization noise) requiring extensive calibration.
motivation: Multi-stage ADC designs require efficient error correction without offline calibration or convergence delays; direct combination of gain-error-shaping (GES) and mismatch-error-shaping (MES) in practical designs is challenging.
method: This is an analog-to-digital converter (a device that converts continuous voltage signals into digital numbers) that processes signals in multiple stages and automatically corrects two types of errors—unequal gain across stages and component-to-component variations—without requiring calibration after manufacturing. Instead of using multi-bit feedback signals that would introduce additional errors, it combines both error corrections through single-bit feedback. It uses a specialized circuit called a negative-resistance-assisted residue integrator to efficiently handle the error signals at each stage.
key_novelty: The key innovation is a single-bit feedback technique that corrects both gain and component mismatches simultaneously without introducing the extra errors that multi-bit feedback approaches require.
contributions: Unified cross-stage gain-mismatch-error-shaping avoiding multi-bit feedback complexity
Negative-R-assisted residue integrator for efficient integration and noise shaping
Calibration-free operation eliminating foreground/background calibration overhead
Achieves 93.3dB SNDR and 180.4dB FoMs without calibration circuits
limitations: Comparison with state-of-the-art calibration-free ADCs and specific sampling rate/power consumption not provided.
primary_theme: Calibration-free pipelined-SAR ADC with unified cross-stage gain-mismatch error shaping
